crumb: Campaign Media Kit · Storyboard · Quest B · Chengdu Panda Base
h1: From panda fandom to a studio the world pays to join
slogan: The world's creators, starring Hua Hua & Fu Bao.
premise: The fan journey runs from a creator's daily panda scroll to an AI short film starring Hua Hua & Fu Bao, a revenue share that pays them, a membership fans join to watch and vote — and the anniversary premiere that turns peak devotion into members.
one_liner: Make the film, share the take, join the studio.

chapters.name: The Spark
chapters.blurb: A creator's daily panda scroll becomes a film with the official stars.

chapters.name: The Take
chapters.blurb: Creators submit and share the revenue; fans join to watch and vote.

chapters.name: The Bond
chapters.blurb: The anniversary premiere and the trip turn membership into belonging.

steps.title: A world already filming the pandas
steps.scene: a creator at home watching Hua Hua & Fu Bao clips, a phone full of panda footage
steps.quote: I've been editing panda clips for years. I'd love to do it with the real thing.
steps.action: Turn the daily panda scroll into an open studio call

meta.goal: Open the studio to the world's creators

ui.title: You already film them
lines: Now film Hua Hua & Fu Bao

steps.title: Make Hua Hua & Fu Bao the stars
steps.scene: a creator planning an AI short film on a phone, the official footage kit on screen
steps.quote: The moment they handed us the real footage, it stopped being fan art.
steps.action: Give creators the official kit — own the reach
steps.source: Creators make the reach; the Base owns none of it (Insight 4)

meta.goal: Recruit creators onto the Studio Pass

ui.title: Official Hua Hua & Fu Bao footage

steps.title: Your film, your take
steps.scene: a creator's submission accepted, a numbered creator certificate and a revenue-share line
steps.quote: Getting paid for the film changed everything — this is a job now, not a hobby.
steps.action: Pay creators — the 20% revenue share is the retention engine
steps.source: Plan capture · Studio Pass: 20% revenue share

meta.goal: Convert creators into a paid creator crew

steps.title: The membership fans join to vote
steps.scene: a household around a tablet joining the Studio Membership and voting on the winning film
steps.quote: For $29 a year we get to actually vote — it feels like we're part of the studio.
steps.action: Convert fans to members at peak emotion
steps.source: ZSL converts day visitors via a ticket upgrade; D2C pages 2–4%

meta.goal: Convert fans into paying Studio Members

ui.title: Watch, vote, go behind the scenes

steps.title: Premiere night — the winning film
steps.scene: the anniversary premiere livestream, the winning film premiering and a numbered collectible drop
steps.quote: We watched the winning film live with a million other people. That was the moment.
steps.action: Gate the anniversary premiere — the year's peak membership moment
steps.source: 6,000 saw Fu Bao off at 4am; 70× lottery odds (Hankyung; dotdotnews)

steps.title: Meet the stars in Chengdu
steps.scene: a member family meeting Hua Hua & Fu Bao at the Base, cameras up, joyful
steps.quote: After a year in the studio, standing in front of them made it real.
steps.action: Bundle the trip — belonging becomes travel
steps.source: Plan capture · members → 'meet the stars' Chengdu trip (OTA)
